meta.task: Todo 2 — client web↔native route parity inventory
meta.stateDetection: States are source-inspected per file (imports/keywords: Skeleton/ActivityIndicator/isLoading, error/retry, EmptyState/empty, real paginators, QR libs, map libs), not inferred from filenames.

authLegend.public: No client session required (auth group / pre-login).
authLegend.client-authenticated: Client session expected; web enforced by requireRole in src/app/(cliente)/layout.tsx. Native relies on session-scoped data (some screens gate/redirect, some do not).
authLegend.redirect-to-login: Native screen explicitly router.replace("/(auth)/login") when unauthenticated.

statusLegend.complete: Native route exists and matches the web route behavior/states (or is an exact redirect twin).
statusLegend.partial: Native route exists but has a state/family/composition gap versus web.
statusLegend.missing: No native route satisfies this web route.
